issue.subject: [infra][qem-bot] ignore jobs in development job groups for increment approval size:S
issue.description:
## Motivation
qem-bot supports features like ignoring development jobs. We need to ensure that such features also work the same for product increment tests.

## Acceptance criteria
* **AC1:** jobs in usual development job groups are ignored for product increment tests as well

## Suggestions
* Look up how development jobs are ignored in other cases and apply the same for product increments as well
